FIELD INCIDENT REPORT
Form FIR-1 (rev. 2026-03)
OPERATOR
Aspen Ridge Pipelines Inc.
REPORTED BY
Area supervisor
RECEIVED VIA
Text messages
DESCRIPTION OF THE EVENT (what happened, when, where, who, what was released)
Got a gas leak at Rosetown station, found it at 0940 this morning. Sweet gas, approx. 24,000 m³
escaped. Looks like it's coming through the pipe body or maybe a weld-haven't pinpointed it
yet.
Contained inside the station fence. Shut down the line, venting to flare. Contractor crew's here
now, starting repairs. Will update when we know more.
Dave
Area Supervisor, Aspen Ridge
SUPERVISOR REVIEW
